bash -c "cat > /root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_exp004_7b_rerun.sh << 'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# exp-004-qwen7b-rerun: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct SICA vs SC on D012 (30 FOLIO + 30 PW)
# GPU: cuda:3, Port: 8003
# K=12, T=0.7, T_ext=0.3 (hardcoded), seed=42
# Rerun with fixed code (normalization fix + temperature separation)

set -e
cd /root/symb_invariant_consensus
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base

export VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER=0
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3

MODEL_DIR=\"/root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct\"
PORT=8003
K=12
TEMPERATURE=0.7
MAX_TOKENS=4096
SEED=42
RESULTS_DIR=\"results/exp004_qwen7b_rerun\"
mkdir -p \"\$RESULTS_DIR\"

echo \"=== [\$(date)] exp-004-qwen7b-rerun: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct SICA vs SC ===\"

# Step 1: Download model if not present
if [ ! -d \"\$MODEL_DIR\" ] || [ ! -f \"\$MODEL_DIR/config.json\" ]; then
    echo \"Downloading Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct...\"
    python -c \"
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download('Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct', local_dir='$MODEL_DIR')
print('DOWNLOAD_DONE')
\"
else
    echo \"Model found at \$MODEL_DIR\"
fi

# Step 2: Start vLLM
echo \"=== [\$(date)] Starting vLLM on port \$PORT ===\"
python -m vllm.entrypoints.openai.api_server \
    --model \"\$MODEL_DIR\" \
    --port \$PORT \
    --tensor-parallel-size 1 \
    --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 \
    --max-model-len 8192 \
    --enforce-eager \
    > /tmp/vllm_exp004_rerun.log 2>&1 &
VLLM_PID=\$!
echo \"vLLM PID: \$VLLM_PID\"

echo \"Waiting for vLLM to be ready...\"
READY=0
for i in \$(seq 1 300); do
    if curl -s http://localhost:\$PORT/v1/models > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo \"vLLM ready after \${i}s\"
        READY=1
        break
    fi
    if ! kill -0 \$VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null; then
        echo \"ERROR: vLLM process died. Check /tmp/vllm_exp004_rerun.log\"
        tail -30 /tmp/vllm_exp004_rerun.log
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 1
done

if [ \$READY -eq 0 ]; then
    echo \"ERROR: vLLM did not start within 300s\"
    tail -30 /tmp/vllm_exp004_rerun.log
    kill \$VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 1
fi

# Step 3: Run SICA pipeline on D012
echo \"=== [\$(date)] Running SICA pipeline: D012, K=\$K ===\"
PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python -u run_full_mvp.py \
    --mode vllm \
    --k \$K \
    --temperature \$TEMPERATURE \
    --max-tokens \$MAX_TOKENS \
    --api-base \"http://localhost:\$PORT/v1\" \
    --model auto \
    --seed \$SEED \
    --math-data data/empty.json \
    --pw-data data/proofwriter_d012.json \
    --folio-data data/folio_d012.json \
    --output \"\$RESULTS_DIR/exp004_rerun_results.json\" \
    --save-intermediates \
    2>&1 | tee \"\$RESULTS_DIR/exp004_rerun.log\"

EXIT_CODE=\$?

# Step 4: Cleanup
echo \"=== [\$(date)] Stopping vLLM ===\"
kill \$VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true
wait \$VLLM_PID 2>/dev/null || true

echo \"Results: \$RESULTS_DIR/exp004_rerun_results.json\"
echo \"Log: \$RESULTS_DIR/exp004_rerun.log\"
echo \"EXIT_CODE=\$EXIT_CODE\"
echo \"EXP004_RERUN_DONE\"
SCRIPT_EOF
chmod +x /root/symb_invariant_consensus/scripts/run_exp004_7b_rerun.sh
echo 'Script created'"
